targetNodeOs.description: Create node OS specific daemonset(s). (e.g. "linux", "windows", "linux windows")

awsAccessKeyID.description: (TESTING USE): These should only be used for testing w/ localstack!

awsEndpoint.description: (TESTING USE): If specified, use the provided AWS endpoint to make API calls.

awsRegion.description: If specified, use the AWS region for AWS API calls

checkTagBeforeDraining.description: If true, check that the instance is tagged with "aws-node-termination-handler/managed" as the key before draining the node

completeLifecycleActionDelaySeconds.description: completeLifecycleActionDelaySeconds will pause for the configured duration after draining the node before completing the EC2 Autoscaling lifecycle action. This may be helpful if Pods on the node have Persistent Volume Claims.

cordonOnly.description: Cordon but do not drain nodes upon spot interruption termination notice.

deleteLocalData.description:
deleteLocalData tells kubectl to continue even if there are pods using
emptyDir (local data that will be deleted when the node is drained).

dryRun.description: dryRun tells node-termination-handler to only log calls to kubernetes control plane

emitKubernetesEvents.description: emitKubernetesEvents If true, Kubernetes events will be emitted when interruption events are received and when actions are taken on Kubernetes nodes. In IMDS Processor mode a default set of annotations with all the node metadata gathered from IMDS will be attached to each event

enableProbesServer.description: If the probes server is running.

enableRebalanceDraining.description: enableRebalanceDraining If true, drain nodes when the rebalance recommendation notice is received. Only used in IMDS mode.

enableRebalanceMonitoring.description: enableRebalanceMonitoring If true, cordon nodes when the rebalance recommendation notice is received. Only used in IMDS mode.

enableScheduledEventDraining.description: enableScheduledEventDraining If false, do not drain nodes before the maintenance window starts for an EC2 instance scheduled event. Only used in IMDS mode.

enableSpotInterruptionDraining.description: enableSpotInterruptionDraining If false, do not drain nodes when the spot interruption termination notice is received. Only used in IMDS mode.

enableSqsTerminationDraining.description: enableSqsTerminationDraining If true, this turns on queue-processor mode which drains nodes when an SQS termination event is received

excludeFromLoadBalancers.description: Exclude node from load balancer before cordoning via the ServiceNodeExclusion feature gate.

ignoreDaemonSets.description: ignoreDaemonSets causes kubectl to skip Daemon Set managed pods.

tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is {{ printf "v%s" .Chart.AppVersion }}

instanceMetadataURL.description: (TESTING USE): Override the default metadata URL (default: http://169.254.169.254:80)

kubernetesEventsExtraAnnotations.description:
kubernetesEventsExtraAnnotations A comma-separated list of key=value extra annotations to attach to all emitted Kubernetes events
Example: "first=annotation,sample.annotation/number=two"

managedTag.description: The tag to ensure is on a node if checkTagBeforeDraining is true

metadataTries.description: Total number of times to try making the metadata request before failing.

nodeTerminationGracePeriod.description: nodeTerminationGracePeriod specifies the period of time in seconds given to each NODE to terminate gracefully. Node draining will be scheduled based on this value to optimize the amount of compute time, but still safely drain the node before an event.

podDisruptionBudget.description:
podDisruptionBudget specifies the disruption budget for the controller pods.
Disruption budget will be configured only when the replicaCount is greater than 1
maxUnavailable: 1

create.description:
Specifies whether PodMonitor should be created
this needs enableSqsTerminationDraining: false
and enablePrometheusServer: true

labels.description: Additional labels to add to the metadata

namespace.description:
Specifies whether the PodMonitor should be created in a different namespace than
the Helm release

podTerminationGracePeriod.description: podTerminationGracePeriod is time in seconds given to each pod to terminate gracefully. If negative, the default value specified in the pod will be used.

procUptimeFile.description: (TESTING USE): Mount path for uptime file

queueURL.description: Listens for messages on the specified SQS queue URL

pspEnabled.description: Specifies if PodSecurityPolicy resources should be created. PodSecurityPolicy will not be created when Kubernetes version is 1.25 or later.

replicas.description: The number of replicas in the NTH deployment when using queue-processor mode (NOTE: increasing this may cause duplicate webhooks since NTH pods are stateless)

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.description: The name of the service account to use. If namenot set and create is true, a name is generated using fullname template

create.description:
Specifies whether ServiceMonitor should be created
this needs enableSqsTerminationDraining: true
and enablePrometheusServer: true

labels.description: Additional labels to add to the metadata

namespace.description:
Specifies whether the ServiceMonitor should be created in a different namespace than
the Helm release

strategy.description: Specify the update strategy for the deployment

taintNode.description: Taint node upon spot interruption termination notice.

targetNodeOs.description: Create node OS specific daemonset(s). (e.g. "linux", "windows", "linux windows")

useHostNetwork.description:
Determines if NTH uses host networking for Linux when running the DaemonSet (only IMDS mode; queue-processor never runs with host networking)
If you have disabled IMDSv1 and are relying on IMDSv2, you'll need to increase the IP hop count to 2 before switching this to false
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/configuring-instance-metadata-service.html

useProviderId.description: If true, fetch node name through Kubernetes node spec ProviderID instead of AWS event PrivateDnsHostname.

webhookHeaders.description: webhookHeaders if specified, replaces the default webhook headers.

webhookProxy.description: webhookProxy if specified, uses this HTTP(S) proxy configuration.

webhookTemplate.description: webhookTemplate if specified, replaces the default webhook message template.

webhookTemplateConfigMapKey.description: template file name stored in configmap

webhookTemplateConfigMapName.description:
webhook template file will be fetched from given config map name
if specified, replaces the default webhook message with the content of the template file

webhookURL.description: webhookURL if specified, posts event data to URL upon instance interruption action.

webhookURLSecretName.description: Webhook URL will be fetched from the secret store using the given name.

workers.description: The maximum amount of parallel event processors to handle concurrent events
